name: Europe
intro: Usually the top prize in a multi-year incentive programme, or the venue for a conference with international delegates. The travel and visa lead times are longer than anything else here, and that is the main thing to plan around.
access: Direct and one-stop flights from Delhi; typically eight to ten hours.
highlights: The strongest reward value available, and the natural flagship for a long-running incentive scheme.
Serious conference infrastructure in the major cities for events with international attendees.
Rail connections between cities make a genuine multi-country itinerary workable.
planning_note: Schengen visa appointment availability is the binding constraint, not flights or hotels, and in peak season slots can be months out. Start a European programme far earlier than you would any other destination — and treat the visa timeline as the project plan.
